name: Open Membership Invoices Query
query:
SELECT
    si.name AS "Invoice:Link/Sales Invoice:120",
    si.posting_date AS "Posting Date:Date:100",
    si.due_date AS "Due Date:Date:100",
    si.grand_total AS "Amount:Currency:120",
    si.outstanding_amount AS "Outstanding:Currency:120",
    m.name AS "Member:Link/Member:120",
    m.member_name AS "Member Name:Data:150",
    m.primary_chapter AS "Chapter:Link/Chapter:150",
    ms.membership_type AS "Membership Type:Link/Membership Type:120"
FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
INNER JOIN `tabMembership` ms ON (
    ms.subscription = si.subscription
    OR (ifnull(ms.subscription, '') = '' AND ms.customer = si.customer)
)
INNER JOIN `tabMember` m ON m.name = ms.member
WHERE si.docstatus = 1
AND si.outstanding_amount > 0
AND ms.docstatus = 1
ORDER BY si.due_date ASC
